Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

that’s enough! phrase

also enough, too much, that’s too much, knock it off!, cut it out, that’s it!, that’s all, knock it off, please, enough of this!

classical

Traupman 102, 108
Traupman 33: knock it off, please, parce (parcite), quaesō
Traupman 336

Parce!

that’s enough!, take it easy!

Other words

  • Ohē, jam satis est! — whoa, that’s enough now!

    also used · classical · Hor. Serm. 1.5.12–13; Mart. 4.89.1; Mart. 4.89.1; Hor. S. 1.5.12–13

    Martial’s hendecasyllable shows the short o: Ohē, jam satis est, ohē, libelle.

  • Tantum est. — that’s all, that’s it

    also used · classical · Plaut. Trin. prol. 22 (Lewis & Short s.v. tantus); Plaut. Merc. 2.2.12: Numquid amplius? — Tantum est. (Lewis & Short); Traupman 109, 393

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut.)

Examples

  • nunc per lectum in latus sē volūtat, quoad pater «Parce!» inquit

    now rolls sideways across the bed, until Dad says, “That’s enough!”composed

  • Hoc nimium est! Satis est!

    That’s too much! That’s enough!composed

  • Haec hāctenus!

    Enough of this!Traupman 310

See also is that enough?, splash, careful, don’t fall.
